part.name: Rounded rectangular perimeter frame
part.description: Single-piece, closed rectangular frame with a large central aperture, long straight perimeter spans, rounded corners, planar front and rear lands, an internal mating wall, and a rounded external spine. No discrete holes, bosses, fasteners, or articulated joints are present. Functional features include the central clearance opening, continuous inner locating interface, continuous planar seating or sealing lands, and impact-resistant outer edge. Structural features include the closed-loop shell, four straight rails, four rounded corner transitions, and multiple continuous fillet bands.
part.symmetry_note: The in-plane rounded-rectangle profile is approximately symmetric about its horizontal and vertical centerlines. The section through the frame thickness is not fully front-to-back symmetric because the two planar lands and surrounding edge bands have different widths and radii.

Section.name: Inner aperture interface
Section.function intent: Provides clearance through the center of the part while locating or surrounding a rectangular mating component. The continuous internal perimeter can also act as a guide, bezel boundary, or secondary sealing interface.
Section.physical behavior: The straight walls constrain lateral translation of an inserted mating component, while the rounded corners prevent interference with corner radii and reduce local stress concentration. The closed internal loop distributes contact and handling loads around the full aperture.
Section.geometry: A continuous rounded-rectangular inner sidewall composed of four planar straight spans joined by four cylindrical corner patches. The wall is inclined through the frame thickness in the model coordinate system.
Section.location: Innermost perimeter surrounding the central opening.

Section.name: Front seating flange
Section.function intent: Provides the principal broad seating, sealing, or visible bezel surface and transfers distributed face-normal loads into the perimeter frame.
Section.physical behavior: The planar annular land spreads compression over a large closed-loop area. Small inner and outer fillets remove sharp edges, improve durability, and transfer stress smoothly between the land, internal wall, and external perimeter.
Section.geometry: A broad planar rounded-rectangular annulus bounded by two segmented radius-2 transition loops. Each transition loop contains four cylindrical straight-span fillets and four toroidal corner fillets.
Section.location: Front-facing side of the frame between the central aperture and the outer perimeter.

Section.name: Outer protective spine
Section.function intent: Defines the external envelope, protects the frame edge, provides a comfortable handling surface, and carries perimeter loads between the two face lands.
Section.physical behavior: The closed rounded spine behaves as a continuous ring beam. Broad convex surfaces resist edge impact and bending, while the large corner radii distribute membrane and bending stresses without sharp corner concentrations.
Section.geometry: Two adjacent rounded-rectangular external surface loops. One loop is a shallow outer shoulder with planar straight spans and radius-63 cylindrical corners; the second is the dominant convex spine with radius-10 cylindrical straight spans and radius-53 toroidal corners.
Section.location: Outermost perimeter of the part, wrapping around all four sides and corners.

Section.name: Rear seating land
Section.function intent: Provides the opposing seating or sealing reference on the rear side and completes the frame cross-section between the inner interface and outer spine.
Section.physical behavior: The planar land accepts distributed compression and stabilizes the frame against rocking. The surrounding small-radius transition loop transfers load into adjacent walls while suppressing sharp-edge stress and chipping.
Section.geometry: A planar rounded-rectangular annular land adjacent to a continuous radius-2 loop made from four cylindrical straight-span fillets and four toroidal corner fillets.
Section.location: Rear-facing side of the frame, opposite the broad front seating flange.
